summary: Keep one pending reconcile retry per item and discard obsolete timer wakes

schema.detail: No database or persisted timer representation changes.

rules.detail: Schedule admission, restart eligibility and retry delays are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No response, wire or client contract changes. Repeated requests retain the earliest pending wake, and cancelled or superseded timers no longer wake reconciliation.

downtime.detail: Deployment follows the existing daemon rollout; restart duration has not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: No configuration or operational action is required by the source change.

recovery.detail: Timers remain transient and are reconstructed through existing reconciliation after restart. No storage recovery behavior changes.
